methods.contextPolicy: Serial fresh storage/cache contexts for each side/mode/profile/sample. Empty browser cache is not cold OS cache. Comparable actions first, then candidate-only actions in fixed listed order. Preparation is retained, not a warmup sample. No selectively discarded samples or outliers.
methods.timing: Wall milliseconds includes actual Playwright input, exactly two requestAnimationFrame callbacks and bounded observed UI readback. Timeline selection latency measures initial selected-row rendering, not animation completion. Preparation may await natural completion; it is not a latency sample.
methods.startup: Not measured here; unchanged run-next-expansion-performance.mjs owns shared27 startup/general cells against the frozen actual parent.
methods.ordering: Side order alternates by sample + mode + profile parity. Each fresh side context uses identical comparable operations/preparation. Candidate-only operations follow both anchor operations and are never assigned baseline zero.

thresholds.baselineVariable: baseline range/median > .25 AND range > 50ms; candidate instability is separately flagged by the same rule

methods.noConcurrency: Operator must run alone. Cooperative lock prevents only this supplement overlapping itself; absence of arbitrary external workloads is not proven.
methods.limits: Real Chromium UI only, not Windows/DC/live or human screen-reader evidence. No acceptance or waiver. Candidate-only medians are descriptive and have no regression/acceptance threshold.
